title: Genesis progression tree (CC-008, sandbox)
description: One levelable track and its authored nodes. Extends genesis-mastery/0.1 (CC-007) without replacing it. Distinguishes: track (owns XP or is driven by another track), node (an authored unlock), grant (what a node gives: feature, executable profile, capacity, prerequisite marker), choice group, milestone, requirement.

id.description: Track identity, e.g. class:sentinel, archetype:sentinel_sentry, species:echani, mastery:telekinetic_control, discipline:force.

status.description: Only 'approved*' content may be promoted; candidate/scaffold never grants live mechanics.

parent.description: parent_linked only: the track whose level/XP this track shares.

xp_quantity.description: Which ledger quantity this track consumes. 'none' = driven by another track's level (driven_by).

driven_by.description: Track id whose level this track follows (archetype ← class; species ← class or its own track).

table.description: table/1: cumulative XP for each level from start_level, starting with 0.

curve_status.description: candidate curves are generated for comparison and are NEVER adopted silently.

cadence.description: Milestone levels for this track (e.g. 3,6,9,12,15,18 or 5,10,15,20).

evidence.description: Eligible evidence for XP (xp_quantity other than none).

exclusive.description: true: once 'picks' are taken the rest of the group is closed. false: unchosen options stay available at later milestones.

milestones.description: Levels at which this group offers a pick.

kind.description: core_grant: automatic at its level from an authoritative source. choice: picked from a choice group. improvement: bounded modifier to an existing capability. subclass_entry: opens an archetype track. prerequisite_marker: no effect, satisfies prerequisites (e.g. completed training).

upgrades.description: Node id this one upgrades (an upgrade chain); requires that node.

legacy_reinterpretation.description: Set by the legacy adapter when an ambiguous legacy prerequisite was read as any_of_group.

requirement.description: Explicit mode. A bare array is NOT accepted in new trees (legacy ambiguity, CC-008 A §2.2).

oneOf.description: A node id in this tree.

type.description: feature: an entitlement (Registry Feature/Power). profile: an executable action profile (catalog/Registry). capacity: a numeric capability value. training_opportunity: eligibility to train, never the power itself. track_unlock: opens another track (archetype).
